result.control_model: time-to-intercept pitch control (insights.control, from physics.pitch_control; simplified Spearman 2018): each player in view reaches a point after a 0.7 s reaction then at 5 m/s; a team's control is its softmin share of the arrival times; positions only, no ball travel time
result.danger_def: Dangerous space in view: the dangerous zone is every cell in front of the goal in view from which a shot is worth at least 0.05 xG (Soccermatics' logistic fit on 8,451 PL 2017/18 Wyscout shots, as in v5/v6). Each team's share = sum over the zone's cells in view of its pitch control x that cell's xG, divided by the sum of the xG; home + away = 1. Printed only when at least 70% of the zone's cells are in view; 2 dp

gates.scope: visible region only: control and danger use the cells the camera shows
gates.trusted: the tracking's camera fit is trusted at the frame, both teams in view, not after a goal (dead ball)

grid.encoding: base64 uint8, row-major y then x (y from the NEAR touchline): P(home controls) x 254 rounded; 255 = cell not in view

result.shape_def: by depth from the team's own goal line, outfield players in view: back_line = the 4 deepest, drawn only when >= 85% of the strip behind the deepest (to the goal line, the penalty area's width) is in view; lines = back 4 / the rest / the 3 most advanced; width_m = touchline-to-touchline spread; depth_m = front line - back line (mean depths); line_gap_m = midfield line - back line; lines, width, depth and gap need >= 9 of 10 outfield players; metres, 2 dp; points listed touchline to touchline (y ascending)
